purpose: Source reconciliation for PanOceania using MUH050224 Infinity RPG - PanOceania Faction Book.pdf from the user's linked Google Drive folder.

source.file: MUH050224 Infinity RPG - PanOceania Faction Book.pdf
source.label: Infinity RPG — PanOceania Faction Book

changes: Added panOceaniaReference with expanded homelands, social status, adolescent events, faction career table, career event routing/results, Military Orders, source career profiles, Helot Lifepath and normalisation notes.
Added 41 PanOceania Homeworld/Homeland choices across Acontecimento, Neoterra, Varuna, Paradiso, Human Edge, Svalarheima and Earth.
Added 16 source-backed PanOceanian faction careers and faction-aware Career filtering.
Added 16 PanO source career profiles with mandatory/elective skills, Earnings, gear and special rules where stated.
Added Helot as a PanOceania Host / Heritage option with AWA +1, PER +1, WIL -1, Life Point Cost 2 and source abilities/rules.
Added six combined Varuna/Sissolu Waters origin choices for Helot characters.
Added ten Helot career names to the sheet's career catalogue and constrained them through Helot Host / Heritage.
Removed Helots from the selectable Faction list while preserving the legacy source record for migration/reference.
Legacy saves using Faction=Helots now migrate to Faction=PanOceania and Host / Heritage=Helot.
Updated glossary Source References for PanO status, expanded homelands, adolescent events, careers, career events, Military Orders and Helot Lifepath.
Print identity now includes Host / Heritage for PanOceania when applicable.
Embedded data.js and app.js inside index.html were updated to exactly match the standalone files.
preservedHouseRules: Main-skill changes continue to propagate to dependent sub-skills.
5 Weapon slots and 10 Equipment slots retained.
Existing Haqqislam and Yu Jing source-career filtering retained.
sourceNormalisation: Persuasion in source text is represented as Persuade to match the sheet's skill name.
Neoterra table extraction shows 'Tecendur System'; chapter naming identifies Tencendur System, used by the sheet.
Varuna table extraction shows 'Hawaki Archipelago'; Chapter 4 naming identifies Hawaiki, used by the sheet.
The sheet combines Homeworld and Homeland in one field, so both broad worlds and source regional homelands are selectable.
